name: Tangoe One Expense Intelligence
description: Tangoe One technology expense analytics: billed spend across mobile, SaaS, UCaaS, network and cloud, zero-usage (zombie) lines and wasted spend by business unit, invoice audit billing errors, disputes and credits recovered by carrier, with the zero-usage line reclaim queue. Synthetic data.

tabs.name: Overview
tabs.description: Spend, zero-usage lines, invoice audit and the reclaim queue

tiles.name: Billed technology spend
tiles.description: Weekly billed spend across mobile, SaaS, UCaaS, network and cloud, last 12 months.

tiles.name: Zero-usage rate
tiles.description: Weekly share of billed lines and licenses with no usage for 30+ days.

tiles.name: Billing error rate
tiles.description: Weekly share of charge lines where invoice audit found a billing error.

tiles.name: Credits recovered
tiles.description: Weekly credits and refunds recovered from vendors through disputes.

tiles.name: Invoice audit flow: service to error type to outcome
tiles.search: [Disputed Amount] [Service Category] [Error Type] [Audit Status] [Audit Status] != 'clean' [Invoice Date] = 'last 12 months'

tiles.name: Zero-usage rate by business unit and service (last 90 days)
Reclaim queue: zero-usage lines and licenses
tiles.search: [Service ID] [Assigned User] [Business Unit] [Vendor] [Billed Amount] [Days Since Last Use] [Recommended Action] = 'cancel line' 'suspend line' 'reclaim license' 'confirm with owner' [Invoice Date] = 'last 30 days' sort by [Days Since Last Use] descending

tiles.name: Field Operations: zombie lines and licenses climbing
tiles.search: [Zero-Usage Rate] [Invoice Date].monthly [Business Unit] [Business Unit] = 'field operations' 'sales' 'manufacturing' 'corporate' [Invoice Date] = 'last 18 months'

tiles.name: Vodafone: billing error rate surge after rate-plan migration
tiles.search: [Billing Error Rate] [Invoice Date].monthly [Vendor] [Vendor] = 'vodafone' 'verizon' 'at&t' 'orange' 'deutsche telekom' [Service Category] = 'mobile' [Invoice Date] = 'last 18 months'

tiles.name: Wasted spend by business unit (last 90 days)
tiles.search: [Wasted Spend] [Business Unit] [Invoice Date] = 'last 90 days' sort by [Wasted Spend] descending
